summary.source: LTAX exports received 19 Oct 2569: PDS 1, 3 and 7 per title (no owner names or taxpayer codes), condo PDS 2/4/8, assessment, payment and debtor registers

cityTotals.basis: assessment register live unique rows; payment register by tax year in the revenue text; debtor register; municipal notice on 2569 collection

limits: PDS 1/3/7 exports carry no owner name or taxpayer code, so portfolios (s.40 farm allowance, s.42 para 2 combining) cannot be computed; only debtor-linked titles have a taxpayer.
Per-parcel payment cannot be allocated without taxpayer codes; payment status is shown only for debtor-linked titles.
A title matched through house numbers (no deed number in the parcel map) is a weaker link than a deed match.
A 2569 tax of 0 is shown only where the roll proves the title fully exempt; blank tax stays unknown.

buildingJoinedTitles.rule: titles that each hold at least 25% and 20 m2 of one building roof are joined (union across buildings); buildings with more than one house number join nothing; a second title that another building of 40 m2 or more, or a building with a different house number, also stands on is not joined
buildingJoinedTitles.use: s.42 para 2 proxy only: one owner and one use are assumed, not known (the PDS files carry no owner per title)
